item.title: SUGGESTION : Change of lane control sign ?, 11th July
item.description:
SUGGESTION : Hi, would you consider changing the lane control sign on approach to the 'Macdonalds roundabout' (PE Way / Tewkesbury Road) ? This is northbound, on PE Way, approaching the roundabout. The single lane splits to two lanes, then the right hand lane splits again. There is no clear indication that in order to TURN RIGHT you need to be in the right most lane. I am a driving instructor, and we would teach to 'default left' when you have a choice of lanes. Here, the default left lane is lane two, and this takes you AHEAD ONLY. Could you amend the metal sign, and/or possibly add a painted right hand arrow to lead right turning traffic to the right most lane ? Thanks for the consideration ! Nat
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Princess Elizabeth Way, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Street sweeper misses detritus, 11th July
item.description:
Great that the street cleaning machine is cleaning our street as it has a high footfall. Problem is it misses all the detritus, pigeon poo and mess that accumulates at the edges of the path especially under and near the Honeybourne bridge. This needs sweeping by hand or a push cleaning machine. It looks a bit of a mess again as there are loads of pigeons sheltering/nesting under the bridge. Please could a routine clean be scheduled for this area? Many thanks
